title: Rosemary Beach: 144 Round Road in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: 144 Round Road in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Blu Manor Cottage & Carriage House

Tucked just behind the Blue Manor , this coastal carriage house offers the perfect blend of comfort and charm—an ideal retreat for guests seeking privacy while staying close to all that Rosemary Beach has to offer.

The first floor features an open-concept layout that seamlessly connects the living area, dining space, and fully equipped kitchen with bar seating for three. A queen bedroom and a full bathroom with a walk-in shower are conveniently located on this level.

A spiral staircase leads to the loft-style primary bedroom, featuring a king bed and a cozy, elevated view of the living space below.

Designed with thoughtful details and warm coastal accents, this carriage house offers everything needed for a relaxing getaway—just a short stroll from the beach, shops, and restaurants of Rosemary Beach.
